---
title: "Software"
subtitle: "Open-source tools for biodiversity data and species distribution modelling"
---

I believe good science needs good, open tools. These are the packages I have created or co-developed. Feedback, issues and pull requests are always welcome!

::::::::: card-grid
::: info-card
### flexsdm

[R]{.sw-badge} [Lead developer]{.sw-badge}

A flexible and comprehensive workflow for species distribution modelling: data pre-processing (occurrence filtering, calibration areas, pseudo-absences/background, data partitioning), model fitting and tuning, ensembles, evaluation, prediction, and post-processing (e.g., overprediction correction, extrapolation metrics).

[Website](https://sjevelazco.github.io/flexsdm/) · [GitHub](https://github.com/sjevelazco/flexsdm) · [Paper](https://doi.org/10.1111/2041-210X.13874)
:::

::: info-card
### adm

[R]{.sw-badge} [Co-developer]{.sw-badge}

Tools to build **abundance-based species distribution models**: data preparation, model tuning and fitting with multiple algorithms (including deep neural networks), validation, spatial prediction, and partial dependence plots.

[Website](https://sjevelazco.github.io/adm/) · [GitHub](https://github.com/sjevelazco/adm) · [Paper](https://doi.org/10.1111/2041-210X.70074)
:::

::: info-card
### bdc

[R]{.sw-badge} [Co-developer]{.sw-badge} [GBIF Ebbe Nielsen 2022]{.sw-badge}

A toolkit for **standardizing, integrating and cleaning biodiversity data** — from merging heterogeneous databases and harmonizing taxonomy to flagging spatial and temporal errors.

[Website](https://brunobrr.github.io/bdc/) · [GitHub](https://github.com/brunobrr/bdc) · [Paper](https://doi.org/10.1111/2041-210X.13868)
:::

::: info-card
### ENMTML

[R]{.sw-badge} [Co-developer]{.sw-badge}

A package for a straightforward construction of complex ecological niche models, integrating data processing, many algorithms, ensembles, and projections in a single function.

[GitHub](https://github.com/andrefaa/ENMTML) · [Paper](https://doi.org/10.1016/j.envsoft.2019.104615)
:::

::: info-card
### pyflexsdm

[Python]{.sw-badge} [Lead developer]{.sw-badge} [In development]{.sw-badge}

A Python implementation of the *flexsdm* workflow for species distribution modelling, built on the scientific Python geospatial stack. Coming soon!
:::

::: info-card
### MSDM

[R]{.sw-badge} [Developer]{.sw-badge}

Methods to reduce overprediction of species distribution models by incorporating spatial constraints, *a priori* and *a posteriori*.

[GitHub](https://github.com/sjevelazco/MSDM/) · [Paper](https://doi.org/10.1016/j.ecolmodel.2020.109180)
:::
:::::::::

## Workshops on these tools

I regularly teach hands-on workshops on *flexsdm* and *adm* (e.g., ESA 2025, ATBC 2026). See [Teaching & Mentoring](teaching.qmd).
